title: ACTIONS SPEAK LOUDER THAN WORDS: AGENT DECISIONS REVEAL IMPLICIT BIASES IN LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring implicit sociodemographic biases (gender, race/ethnicity, and political ideology) in Large Language Models through agent simulations.
